title: Rules
description: Simple trigger → condition → action rules that run on every matching event, in order.
editor_description: Pick a trigger, narrow it with conditions and list the actions to run.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view automation rules.
empty: No rules yet. Create one to tag, assign or reply automatically.
error.title: Rules could not be loaded
columns.name: Rule
order_note: Rules run in ascending order. A rule with “stop after match” ends the evaluation for that event. A rule never re-triggers itself.
trigger_hint: The event that starts the rule. Scheduled rules check open conversations at the set interval.
conditions_hint: Combine fields with AND (all) / OR (any) groups. With no condition the rule matches every conversation.
actions_hint: Run in order; a failing step stops the rest and is shown in the run log.
fields.name: Name
fields.enabled_hint: Inactive rules are kept but never run.
fields.stop_on_match_hint: Later rules are skipped for this event when this one matches.
toast.failed: The rule could not be saved. Try again.
delete.title: Delete rule?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will stop running. Its run log stays.
issues.name: Enter a name (up to 200 characters).
issues.schedule: Enter an interval between 1 minute and 1 year (525,600 minutes).
issues.too_many_actions: You can add at most {{count}} actions.
issues.action_type: This action is not available in rules. Pick another one.
test.title: Test the rule
test.description: Checks whether the saved conditions match a conversation. No action runs.
test.matched: Conditions match: the actions would run.
test.not_matched: Conditions do not match: nothing would run.
test.hypothetical: Evaluated with your permissions; nothing was changed or logged.
